bio: Isabella Moraco was born on 14 June 1676 at San Mango di Aquino in Calabria, the daughter of Pietro Moraco and Catarina Riccio. She married Ferdinando Maletta and was John's 10th-great-grandmother. She died some time between 1719 and 1747.
